title: Reading Drill — Comparing reusable coffee filters — Preparing a second trial
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing reusable coffee filters — Preparing a second trial
passages.body:
**A** In Brackenton, work on filters losing their shape after repeated rinsing had already produced a small collection of shape templates. The coffee stall operator used this material to plan a second trial. The first report contained several different figures, but for the second trial the group agreed to publish one main outcome: changes in filter diameter.

**B** The group kept a different drying position for the new trial, which was planned to run for six weeks. Volunteers were shown a sample record before starting. They were also asked to describe anything unusual in a separate note, so later readers could tell the difference between an ordinary value and one taken during a disruption.

**C** The trial design stated that wear from stirring should be recorded even when everything else appeared normal. If this information was missing, the team would leave the field blank rather than infer an answer. It would publish a provisional finding and label it clearly if too few readings were available for a reliable result.
